errors.text_span: 绿色柱最高，代表“无”特征时WER最高，约为35%；蓝色柱次之，约为28%；黄色柱再次之，约为25%；深绿色柱最低，约为22%
errors.evidence: The description provides single approximate values for each bar series, which is a significant over-generalization. The chart shows a clear downward trend in WER values from Test1 to Test5 for all methods. For example, the green bar ('无') is ~36% in Test1 but drops to ~29% by Test5; stating it is '约为35%' obscures this important trend.

errors.text_span: 各测试集之间柱高趋势保持一致
errors.evidence: This phrase is ambiguous. While the relative order of bar heights within each group (无 > i-vector > d-vector > s-vector) is consistent, the absolute heights of the bars are not consistent across test sets; they generally decrease from Test1 to Test5. The sentence could be misinterpreted as claiming the absolute values are consistent.
